title: DNA methylation profiling identifies long-range epigenetic silencing of clustered protocadherins as a key determinant of meningioma progression [discovery]
needs_manual_review_reason: Series-level GEO metadata verified directly against the live source; per-sample clinical/pathology fields (grade, sex/age, anatomic location, brain invasion, treatment timepoint) have not yet been extracted from individual GSM records or supplementary tables. FACT-CHECK UPDATE (2026-07-10): date_deposited/date_updated filled in from Series_submission_date/Series_last_update_date (previously 'Not reported' despite being present live); related_accessions was missing sibling subseries GSE304093 (cell-line arm of the same GSE304097 SuperSeries), added; treatment_timepoint_status filled in as primary/recurrent per overall_design ('n=231 primary and recurrent human meningioma samples'); platform expanded to include the GPL33022 platform title (Illumina Infinium MethylationEPIC v2.0 array). CORRECTION (2026-07-10, second pass): has_outcome_data was briefly marked true based on the series summary's statement that the hypermethylation signature 'is correlated with clinical outcomes,' but a direct check of an individual GSM record (GSM9143071) shows the only per-sample characteristic actually deposited is 'tissue: meningioma'; no survival, recurrence-free-survival, or vital-status field exists anywhere in this series. The summary's outcome-correlation claim describes an analytical finding of the paper, not deposited per-sample data. Reverted to 'Not reported' per the Phase -2 standard of not inferring a field from an indirect claim. AUDIT 2026-07-14 (live-source deep audit): the companion record figshare-32043249-methylation-project.json (same Merk/Tabatabai discovery cohort) documents its own 2026-07-14 audit pass as having 'cross-linked' this GSE304094 record with a matching note -- but on inspection this file had NOT actually been updated to reflect that relationship (related_accessions/source_urls/notes here made no mention of the Figshare deposit at all), so that cross-link claim was not yet true for this file; corrected now. Re-confirmed directly: figshare-32043249-methylation-project's own live Figshare metadata contains meta_discovery_current.csv with 231 rows, and 3 of its 'ID' values (T26_0053, T26_0137, T26_0019) exactly match 3 live GSM sample titles fetched directly from this series (GSM9143071, GSM9143072, GSM9143080), confirming this Figshare deposit holds the rich clinical/pathology annotation table (grade, sex, brain invasion, priorRT/adjuvantRT, survival, methylation-class) for these exact same 231 discovery-cohort specimens. Added '10.6084/m9.figshare.32043249' to related_accessions and its source URL below. Per the same precedent already established on the Figshare record's own side, this record's own fields are deliberately NOT overwritten with the Figshare deposit's values: GSE304094's own live GEO record (re-checked this session, GSM9143071/72/73 etc.) still exposes only 'tissue: meningioma' at the per-sample level, with no grade/sex/age/invasion/outcome fields deposited in GEO itself, so grade_breakdown/sex_distribution/age_distribution/has_outcome_data/brain_invasion/molecular_subtype_annotated here correctly remain Not reported/null/false pending a decision on whether to merge companion-source data into GEO-sourced records generally; the Figshare deposit is the authoritative place to look up that clinical annotation for now. Live GEO re-check also reconfirms sample_count=231 and no linked publication yet exists for this series (Series page still shows no PubMed ID).
